_doc: MCP wiring for the evaluator. The frontend rubric requires the evaluator to drive the running app, not just review files.
Two parallel paths are supported and both are enforced by hooks/heartbeat-stop.sh:
1. Browser tasks  -> Playwright MCP (default). Trace lands at playwright-mcp/round-N/trace.zip.
2. Desktop / OS tasks -> native computer use (Claude `computer_*` tool family or Codex equivalent). Session log lands at computer-use/round-N/session.jsonl.
The heartbeat hook reads the active rubric from .claude/goal-state/goal-state.json and refuses goal-completion if interaction evidence is required and missing.

Uncomment the computer-use server block on machines where you actually want the evaluator to drive a desktop. Leaving it off means desktop tasks must fall back to scripted evidence and will not auto-pass the trace gate.

_computer_use_example.doc: Uncomment into mcpServers when you have a computer-use MCP server installed (Anthropic ships one for Claude; Codex CLI has a built-in equivalent). The harness only requires that, if used, the evaluator writes its action log to computer-use/round-${round}/session.jsonl in the workspace.
